title: Senate Democrats Block $1.15 Trillion Defense Bill Over Iran War and Israel Provisions
detail: The Senate voted 50-46 against advancing the National Defense Authorization Act, falling short of the 60 votes needed for cloture. Democrats objected to proceeding with the must-pass, normally-bipartisan defense bill while President Trump escalates military operations against Iran without new congressional authorization, and also cited a provision deepening US-Israel intelligence and military integration. Senate Majority Leader John Thune switched his vote procedurally to preserve the ability to bring the bill back up later.

media.caption: Senate Democrats block the NDAA over Iran war and Israel provisions

title: House Passes Sunshine Protection Act, Making Daylight Saving Time Permanent
detail: The House passed the Trump-backed Sunshine Protection Act 308-117, which would eliminate the twice-yearly clock change and keep the country on the time currently observed March-November (states retain an option to opt out before the law takes effect). The bill now heads to the Senate, where a companion measure previously stalled after Sen. Tom Cotton (R-AR) objected over concerns about dark winter mornings.

media.caption: House passes the Sunshine Protection Act 308-117, ending twice-yearly clock changes

title: June CPI Shows Inflation Cooling to 3.5% as Energy Prices Retreat
detail: Headline CPI rose 3.5% year-over-year in June 2026, down from 4.2% in May and the first pullback since January 2026, beating forecasts of 3.8%. Core CPI (ex food/energy) rose 2.6% YoY. The deceleration was driven by a 5.7% month-over-month drop in the energy index as the Iran-conflict-driven oil price spike unwound, though energy remained up 15.7% year-over-year.

media.caption: BLS June 2026 CPI report shows inflation cooling to 3.5% year-over-year
